preserves: Candidate-E feature formulas and 10000 log-ratio scaling
raw Kalshi midpoint benchmark and fixed market-logit offset
no regularization, no standardization, no hyperparameter search
event-equal log loss and Brier reporting
H1 seven-block rolling-origin candidate selection and nested-complexity logic
Checkpoint-19D-B source identities and causal no-imputation rules

historical_state_realization.kalshi_probability: latest valid real KXBTCD one-minute two-sided YES quote at or before scheduled TTC target with <=60s staleness; no future quote and no fill-forward beyond 60s
historical_state_realization.historical_primary_price: exact last-fully-completed UTC one-minute Coinbase candle close
historical_state_realization.historical_verifier_price: latest Kraken trade in the exact minute bucket with publication_ts <= decision time
historical_state_realization.lookback_rule: exact completed minute 300 seconds before current bucket
historical_state_realization.transport_note: H1/H2/H3 use causal historical primitives; later live confirmation returns to 19D-B live Coinbase-BBO primary plus Kraken-PreTrade verifier and live quality gates.

historical_pipeline.ordering: sort untouched events by strike_date_utc then event_ticker; apply frozen structural/source eligibility without outcomes

H1_train.outcome_access: authorized only after 19F universe/materialization freeze validates
H1_train.role: fit and rolling-origin-select between the two already-frozen Candidate-E variants
H1_train.selection_layout: same seven contiguous blocks and five rolling-origin score folds frozen in 19E
H1_train.if_family_fails: stop; H2 and H3 outcomes remain unopened

H2_validation.outcome_access: prohibited until H1 selects exactly one Candidate-E specification
H2_validation.role: one-time untouched historical validation of the selected H1 specification
H2_validation.block_rule: five contiguous chronological event-count blocks differing by at most one; earlier blocks receive remainder
H2_validation.if_fail: Candidate E historical validation FAIL; H3 outcomes remain unopened
H2_validation.if_pass: freeze selected specification and refit final parameters once on H1+H2 before H3

H3_locked_test.outcome_access: prohibited until H2 passes and final H1+H2 model parameters are frozen
H3_locked_test.role: one-time locked untouched historical terminal test
H3_locked_test.block_rule: five contiguous chronological event-count blocks differing by at most one; earlier blocks receive remainder
H3_locked_test.gate: same numerical/coverage conditions as H2 validation gate, applied once to frozen final model
H3_locked_test.if_fail: Candidate E closed as historical test FAIL; H3 becomes exposed and may never be reused as untouched evidence
H3_locked_test.if_pass: Candidate E becomes eligible only for prospective live confirmation; no execution authorization

reserve_policy.extension_rule: extend chronologically without outcome access only to replace events failing frozen eligibility; never relax thresholds

nominal_raw_queue_boundaries.interpretation: outcome-blind reference boundaries from the raw untouched queue only; final eligible cohort boundaries may extend later because of frozen data-quality exclusions
